3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: When I entered the War Room, General Taddeus Azaro was in his wheelchair next to the window.

4.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
4.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == false)

5.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
5.text: "All my life, I was told I was meant for greatness."

6.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
6.text: "Once again, presenting the same news that I delivered to King Valero so many years ago."

7.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
7.text: "My life has been nothing but a series of failures."

8.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
8.text: "Yet here I am. Defeated, unworthy. I can't even stand on my own two feet."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "There is always hope. No matter how dire the situation is."

13.speaker: Lucita Azaro
13.text: "We have news from the frontline, Your Majesty."

14.speaker: Lucita Azaro
14.text: "Pales still stands despite our attacks on their heartland."

18.speaker: Lucita Azaro
18.text: "The Palesian army has pushed us back from the border into the Pales Administrative District."

19.speaker: Lucita Azaro
19.text: "We've lost Terador and Fort Ales. The frontline is broken."

20.speaker: Lucita Azaro
20.text: "Once we exhausted our troops, they managed to push us back, retaking Arces."

21.speaker: Lucita Azaro
21.text: "We are holding them at the frontline on an equal footing."

22.speaker: Lucita Azaro
22.text: "They do not seem to be currently advancing."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "No. I have failed. This burden is mine to bear."

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: Her words sank deep into my mind.

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "There is no one to blame. We must look to the future."

27.speaker: Player_Romus
27.text: "And where were you when we were losing this war, Duchess?"

28.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
28.text: "Please don't blame my daughter, Your Majesty. This is entirely on me, not her."

29.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
29.text: "I know, Your Majesty. It is all my fault."

30.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
30.text: "That's generous of you to say, Your Majesty. But we all know but we all know the failure is mine."

31.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
31.text: "No, Your Majesty. It is all my fault. I'm the one whose to blame. Not you."

32.speaker: Lucita Azaro
32.text: "Before we figure out who is to blame, I suggest we discuss what happens next."

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_CanWeWin"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_ParliamentProposesPeace"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false)

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "Do you think we should sue for peace?"
35.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_PeaceDeal"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_ParliamentProposesPeace"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false)

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "How long can we afford to keep the war going?"
36.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_HowLong"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_ParliamentProposesPeace"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false)

37.speaker: Player_Romus
37.text: "Would the Palesians be able to march on Porte Drazon?"
37.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_MarchPorteDrazon"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_ParliamentProposesPeace"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false)

51.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
51.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_CanWeWin"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_PeaceDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_HowLong"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_MarchPorteDrazon"] == true

52.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
52.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_CanWeWin"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_PeaceDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_HowLong"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_MarchPorteDrazon"] == true) == false

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "In light of this information, I know what needs to be done."
57.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_CanWeWin"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_PeaceDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_HowLong"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_MarchPorteDrazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_ParliamentProposesPeace"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false)

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "I don't need to discuss anything. The path forward is clear. I know what needs to be done."
58.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_CanWeWin"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_PeaceDeal"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_HowLong"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_WarLoss_MarchPorteDrazon"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_ParliamentProposesPeace"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Monarch_Veto"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false)

59.speaker: Lucita Azaro
59.text: "With the current state of the war, no. But, times change, Your Majesty."

60.speaker: Lucita Azaro
60.text: "If we keep the war going, we might eventually have an opportunity."

61.speaker: Lucita Azaro
61.text: "If we sue for peace, we will lose face in the eyes of the world."

62.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
62.text: "Yes, however, our enemy might seize one for themselves."

64.speaker: Lucita Azaro
64.text: "I think we should keep this going as far as we can. The international ramifications would render Rizia crippled."

65.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
65.text: "I disagree. This war can bring down Rizia along with Pales. Not to mention the resources we have already spent."

66.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
66.text: "We should sue for peace and look forward as a country."

67.speaker: Lucita Azaro
67.text: "Unless the situation changes drastically... potentially years."

68.speaker: Lucita Azaro
68.text: "In the end, we have more resources than Pales. We would win the war of attrition."

69.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
69.text: "We would, yes. But at what cost?"

72.speaker: Lucita Azaro
72.text: "If they keep pushing into Montaklar, they will gain a foothold in Rizia's heartland."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "We will approach Pales to sue for peace. I do not wish any more blood to be spilled."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "We will continue fighting until the last drop of blood. We have to keep pushing."

81.speaker: Lucita Azaro
81.text: "Very well. Peace it is, Your Majesty."

82.speaker: Narrator
82.text: General Azaro looked outside the window again.

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: He turned his wheelchair toward me. Lucita helped him out of it.

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "Taddeus Azaro. In light of your failures and incompetence, you are hereby incarcerated for a time of my choosing."

93.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
93.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Disgraced"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == false

94.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
94.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Disgraced"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == false) == false

95.speaker: Narrator
95.text: I noticed the marks on his uniform where his medals used to be. I sat at the table.
95.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Disgraced"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == false

96.speaker: Player_Romus
96.text: "Taddeus Azaro, you will leave your post immediately and relinquish all of your duties. I am de-ranking you to Colonel."

97.speaker: Player_Romus
97.text: "You will continue to serve the Crown as you have before."

99.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
99.text: "Yes, my King. I accept my change in rank."

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: She helped him back into his chair.

101.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
101.text: "Thank you for your time, Your Majesty."

102.speaker: Narrator
102.text: They bowed to me and left the room.

110.speaker: Lucita Azaro
110.text: "For your own good, Your Majesty... Romus. Listen to me."

111.speaker: Lucita Azaro
111.text: "For your own good, Your Majesty, listen to me."

112.speaker: Lucita Azaro
112.text: "You’re about to cross a line you can’t uncross."

115.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
115.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == false

116.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
116.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == false) == false

117.speaker: Lucita Azaro
117.text: "Please reconsider. For our sake. Yours, mine, and..."
117.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == false

118.speaker: Player_Romus
118.text: "Lucita Azaro. You will share your fathers' fate. I am sentencing you to prison for your transgressions and insults against the King."

119.speaker: Lucita Azaro
119.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Taddeus_Executed"] == false) == false

126.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
126.text: "Please, Your Majesty! Just take me! I am the one who is responsible, not Lucita."

127.speaker: Lucita Azaro
127.text: "WHAT?! Are you out of your mind?"

133.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
133.text: "But don't lock up my daughter as well. She shouldn't pay for my mistakes."

134.speaker: Narrator
134.text: The old man's eyes were teary.

135.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
135.text: "I beg you. I will do anything..."

137.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
137.text: Signal to the guards to take them both away.

138.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

139.text: "How dare you touch me? Do you know who I am?"

141.text: The guards took them away and closed the door after them.

142.speaker: Narrator
142.text: I was left all alone in the War Room.

144.speaker: Narrator
144.text: Guards put the old man back in his wheelchair and took him out of the room.

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: Lucita stared at me in disbelief as she left.

146.speaker: Narrator
146.text: The door closed with a loud bang.

151.speaker: Lucita Azaro
151.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false)

156.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
156.text: "Yes, my King. I thank you profusely for your forgiveness."

163.speaker: Lucita Azaro
163.text: "What about our unborn son, for God's sake?"

205.text: "Regardless, if I may, I suggest we discuss next steps."

209.text: "That's generous of you to say, Your Majesty. But we all know this failure rests on my shoulders."

213.text: "Please don't blame Lucita, Your Majesty. This is entirely on me, not her."

217.text: "I know, Your Majesty. It is all my fault."

218.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
218.text: "I know, Your Majesty. This is entirely my fault."

225.text: "Given the current state of the war, no. That said, the tide of war can turn, Your Majesty."

226.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
226.text: "If we stay the course, an opportunity might present itself."

227.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
227.text: "However, our enemy might seize one for themselves."

248.text: "But it would come at a cost."

258.text: "Yes, but it would come at a cost."

267.text: "If they keep pushing into Montaklar, they will gain a foothold in Rizia's interior."

271.text: "Very good, Your Majesty. I knew you would."

279.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
279.text: "As you wish, Your Majesty. Peace it shall be."

284.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
284.text: "All my life, I believed I was destined to serve a higher purpose -- that I was meant for greatness."

285.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
285.text: "Once again, presenting the same news that Taddeus Azaro delivered to your father so many years ago."

286.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
286.text: "I fear I will be remembered not for my achievements, but for my failures."

287.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
287.text: "Yet here I am. Defeated in battle."

292.text: He cast his eyes down in shame.

301.speaker: Narrator
301.text: He faced me again and took a deep bow.

311.speaker: Player_Romus
311.text: "Carlos Robles Azaro, you will leave your post immediately and relinquish all of your duties. I am de-ranking you to Colonel."

316.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
316.text: "Yes, my King. I acknowledge my change in my rank."

320.speaker: Narrator
320.text: He lowered himself back into his chair.

324.speaker: Narrator
324.text: He bowed once more before my guards came in and wheeled him out of the room.

328.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
328.text: "Yes, my King. I can't thank you enough for your forgiveness."

329.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
329.text: "I am grateful for your time, Your Majesty."

331.text: He bowed to me and left the room.

332.speaker: Narrator
332.text: He turned his wheelchair toward me, then, with visible effort, he struggled as he lifted himself out of it.

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: My guards put the old man back in his wheelchair and took him out of the room.

339.speaker: Narrator
339.text: The door closed behind them with a loud bang.

343.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
343.text: "Which means Rizia would face the possibility of being dragged down along with Pales."

344.speaker: Narrator
344.text: Carlos saluted, his hand trembling slightly in my presence.

345.speaker: Narrator
345.text: I gestured for him to join me at the table, and he promptly did.

369.text: "Yet here I am. The shameful last scion of a disgraced noble house."

373.text: "So you admit it. The vaunted House of Azaro is nothing but a bunch of weaklings who don't deserve the Crown's mercy."

377.text: "The Prime Minister was rather irate that you vetoed the parliament's ceasefire bill. The government's now insisting we sue for peace."

381.text: "The Prime Minister and our new parliament have already expressed their wish to sue for peace."

403.text: "So why even bother meeting with me?"

409.text: "We should have done so already. *I* should have."
